main_text.l: los, quod unum possumus, in æ-terno silentio defodi: Cur cloa-cam moves? cur portentis illis cor-tinam aperis ? Impius in genus tuum quisquis es nugator.

l.i: An expediat viros doctos, divi-tes, an, ut sit, pauperes esse?

main_text.l: NAturalis amplitudinis Doctrinæ vindices Divitiæ: Alioqui ad po-stem Egestatis alligata, necquicquam in valvis ejus pro-micat, & indignans lora tendit, ad sui fermè strangulatum. O si Musarum Mystæ: ô si Aureum illud Numen, propitiâ manu laxet il-lam, quæ tam malè nos habet, re-stim! Quàm grata foret inassuetis pedibus, patens in excursum a-rea!

page.notes: Spelling and abbreviations are as printed. Initial letter reads as a large woodcut N, joined to "Aturalis" as "NAturalis".
